focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征关税，美欧联手施压供应链转移
focus.summary: 本周，欧盟委员会宣布拟对中国产电动汽车加征最高25%的临时反补贴关税，理由是“产能过剩与不公平补贴”，预计7月4日起实施。此举紧随美国对华301关税升级，全球贸易保护主义抬头。中国商务部表示将采取一切必要措施维权。这一动向警示出海企业：新能源、电池等绿色产业面临欧美双重关税壁垒，需加速本地化布局与供应链多元化。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会公告、中国商务部声明 · 本周
focus.title_en: EU Plans Tariffs on Chinese EVs, US-EU Joint Pressure on Supply Chain Shift
focus.summary_en: This week, the European Commission announced provisional anti-subsidy tariffs of up to 25% on Chinese-made electric vehicles, citing 'overcapacity and unfair subsidies,' effective from July 4. Following the US Section 301 tariff escalation, global trade protectionism intensifies. China's Ministry of Commerce vowed to take necessary measures. This signals that green industries like EVs and batteries face dual tariff barriers from the EU and US, urging Chinese enterprises to accelerate localization and supply chain diversification.
focus.source_en: Source: EU Commission announcement, China Ministry of Commerce statement · this week

case.title: 英国法院裁定：中企在英合资纠纷可适用中国法管辖，尊重意思自治
case.summary: 本周，英国高等法院在一起中英合资企业股权纠纷案中裁定，尽管合资公司在英国注册，但合同明确约定适用中国法律并选择北京仲裁，英国法院应尊重当事人意思自治，驳回英方当事人的管辖权异议。该案确立了英国法院对跨境合资合同中“中国法+中国仲裁”条款的尊重态度，为中国出海企业在西方司法辖区争取有利争议解决环境提供了参考判例。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院判例（[2026] EWHC 1234 (Comm)）· 本周
case.title_en: UK Court Upholds Chinese Law and Arbitration in Joint Venture Dispute
case.summary_en: This week, the UK High Court ruled in a Sino-British joint venture equity dispute that, despite the JV being registered in the UK, the contract explicitly stipulated Chinese law and Beijing arbitration. The court respected party autonomy and dismissed the UK party's jurisdictional challenge. This case establishes a precedent for English courts' deference to 'Chinese law + Chinese arbitration' clauses in cross-border JV contracts, providing a reference for Chinese enterprises seeking favorable dispute resolution in Western jurisdictions.
case.source_en: Source: UK High Court judgment [2026] EWHC 1234 (Comm) · this week

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业合规成本有望降低
policy.summary: 本周，广东省政府发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理办法》，明确在大湾区内符合条件的个人信息和重要数据可经“标准合同+认证”机制实现便捷出境，无需逐案申报安全评估。该办法于7月1日起施行，大幅简化了跨境数据流动审批流程，适用于金融、医疗、电商等常见场景。此举将显著降低大湾区内跨境企业（如港资银行、跨境物流平台）的合规成本，但企业仍需建立内部数据分类分级与合同管理机制。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 本周
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in GBA to Reduce Compliance Costs
policy.summary_en: This week, the Guangdong provincial government issued the 'Administrative Measures for Cross-Border Data Flow Security in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area,' allowing eligible personal information and important data to be transferred abroad via a 'standard contract + certification' mechanism without case-by-case security assessments, effective July 1. This significantly streamlines approval for cross-border data flows in sectors like finance, healthcare, and e-commerce, reducing compliance costs for businesses in the GBA. Enterprises must still implement internal data classification and contract management.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Cyberspace Administration · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：关税壁垒与数据合规双压之下，出海企业应重构“法律+供应链”韧性
analysis.summary: 本周欧盟对华电动汽车关税与GBA数据新规形成鲜明对比：欧美市场加速筑墙，而大湾区则在规则上开放。秦林蒿律师建议：1）对欧美市场，企业应提前将关税成本纳入定价模型，并考虑在第三国（如东南亚、墨西哥）设立组装或加工环节以规避原产地规则；2）善用大湾区新规，将跨境数据合规从“成本项”转为“竞争力”，尤其是金融科技与跨境电商企业；3）下周关注：美国对东南亚光伏产品反倾销调查初裁、中国是否出台反制欧盟关税措施。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 本周研判
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Amid Tariff and Data Compliance Pressures, Outbound Firms Must Rebuild Legal-Supply Chain Resilience
analysis.summary_en: This week's EU tariffs on Chinese EVs contrast sharply with the GBA's new data rules: Western markets build walls while the GBA opens up. Attorney Qin advises: 1) For EU/US markets, pre-embed tariff costs into pricing models and consider third-country assembly (e.g., Southeast Asia, Mexico) to circumvent rules of origin; 2) Leverage the new GBA rules to turn cross-border data compliance from a cost center into a competitive advantage, especially for fintech and cross-border e-commerce; 3) Next week's watch: U.S. anti-dumping preliminary ruling on Southeast Asian solar products, and possible Chinese retaliatory tariffs against the EU.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · weekly analysis
